name: Nexora
summary:
Nexora is a free chat app from Xscape Interactives for hanging out with friends and communities, now on your headset.

Chat your way

Create your own spaces with text topics and voice channels, or join public ones in Discover
Send messages, pictures, GIFs, custom emojis and audio files
Run polls, pin messages, and react to anything
Message friends one-on-one

Talk face to face

Join voice channels with up to 8 people
Start 1-on-1 voice and video calls
Turn on your camera and share your screen

Make it yours
